name: csx-tabs
title: CSX Tabs
description: Jump to the terminal tab where an AI coding agent runs, or to any terminal tab. Works with Ghostty, iTerm2, Terminal, kitty, WezTerm and tmux.
author: mysqto

commands.name: search-ai-sessions
commands.title: Search AI Sessions
commands.subtitle: CSX
commands.description: List the terminal tabs that run an AI coding agent, such as Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI, and focus one.

commands.name: search-terminal-tabs
commands.title: Search Terminal Tabs
commands.subtitle: CSX
commands.description: List every terminal tab and focus one.

preferences.name: csxPath
preferences.title: CSX Path
preferences.description: Full path to the csx binary. Leave empty to look in the Homebrew, MacPorts and Cargo folders.

preferences.name: showAutomated
preferences.title: Automated Sessions
preferences.label: Show automated sessions
preferences.description: Also list sessions that a program or another AI agent started, such as print mode, SDK runs and subagents.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
